solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Comedian's agent pocketing a grand

indicators.note: to pocket something is to take it inside, so the agent holds the next pieces within

parts.note: a G-man is an American slang term for an FBI agent
G is short for a grand, a thousand pounds or dollars

explanation.surface: A comic's agent skims off a thousand as commission.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is a link ('is'): the definition is just 'Comedian'.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer or performer of jokes is a comic; the word is a synonym for a comedian.

clue.text: Creates illumination for opening of Gregorian manuscript found in meadow? On the contrary

indicators.note: found in says one piece sits within another; the contrary phrase then swaps which holds which
On the contrary flips the stated relation, so the meadow goes inside rather than outside
the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for a meadow

explanation.surface: A monk lights up a Gregorian manuscript discovered lying in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: Taken literally, the opening letter and manuscript would sit in the meadow; 'On the contrary' swaps that, so the meadow goes inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: To shine or glint is to give off light, so it describes producing illumination.

clue.text: Good Book again bears fruit

parts.note: to book again, for a performer, is to re-engage them

explanation.surface: The Bible, consulted once more, produces fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Good Book' looks like the Bible; it is G plus 'Book again'.
explanation.definitionFit: A greengage is a kind of green plum, a type of fruit.

clue.text: State of a lager I brewed

indicators.note: brewed, as of beer, suggests the letters are mixed up and stewed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A country where the drinker brewed his own lager.
explanation.definitionFit: A North African country is a sovereign nation, which is a state.

clue.text: Too many words, essentially adverbial, become dated

indicators.note: essentially points to the core of the word, dropping its outer letters

parts.note: to age is to grow old or become dated

explanation.surface: A grammarian complains that adverbial padding makes prose old-fashioned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' keeps the inner part of ADVERBIAL, dropping AD and AL to leave VERBI.
explanation.definitionFit: Verbiage is wordiness, an excess of language beyond what is needed.

clue.text: Keen but not active? That's a bore

indicators.note: not says the following letter is left out of the word

parts.note: eager means keen
A is the grammar abbreviation for active

explanation.surface: Someone keen but passive is a tedious person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bore' is not a dull person but a tidal wave up a river; the Eger (or eagre) is one, as on the Severn.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal surge rolling up an estuary is called a bore, and this is another name for that wave.

clue.text: Get away, going to Iowa leaving behind English flower

indicators.note: going to says the next piece joins on after the first
leaving behind means a letter is dropped from what has been built

parts.note: begone is an old command meaning get away
IA is the postal abbreviation for Iowa

explanation.surface: Someone told to leave goes to Iowa, abandoning an English bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: BEGONE plus IA gives BEGONEIA; 'leaving behind' drops the E of English.
explanation.definitionFit: A begonia is a garden plant grown for its showy blooms.

clue.text: Turning over in sleep, a gastronome's yawning

indicators.note: Turning over says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A gourmet sleeps open-mouthed, turning over in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' marks the hidden letters EPAGA, which 'Turning over' reads backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Agape means wide open, as a mouth gaping in a yawn.

clue.text: Time in twilight for equestrian competition

indicators.note: in places the time letter inside the word for twilight

parts.note: twilight is the evening

explanation.surface: Riders compete as the light fades.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventing is a horse-riding contest combining dressage, cross-country and jumping.

clue.text: Drive finding green disconcerted first of youths

indicators.note: disconcerted means thrown into disorder, so the letters are scrambled
first of takes the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A novice is put off upon spotting a crowd of youngsters.
explanation.definitionFit: Drive in the sense of vigour or get-up-and-go is a synonym.

clue.text: Socialist serious actor

parts.note: a red is a socialist or communist
grave means serious

explanation.surface: A left-wing, earnest thespian.
explanation.walkthrough: Fittingly, the Redgrave acting family (Vanessa, Michael) were known for left-wing politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Michael Redgrave was a celebrated English stage and screen performer.

clue.text: Hybrids would be no good in mushrooms …

indicators.note: in puts the no-good letters inside the mushrooms

parts.note: morels are edible mushrooms

explanation.surface: Crossbred fungi turn out to be useless.
explanation.definitionFit: Mongrels are animals or plants of mixed breed, that is, crosses.

clue.text: Heather's holding popular material

indicators.note: holding means one word clasps the other inside it

parts.note: ling is a common heather
in means popular or fashionable

explanation.surface: A woman named Heather has a well-liked fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: Heather looks like a woman's name; it is the plant ling.
explanation.definitionFit: Lining is fabric sewn inside a garment, so it is a material.

clue.text: … to consume by way of mouth — not seriously?

indicators.note: by way of mouth means spoken, so a phrase is heard rather than read

parts.note: something said in jest is not meant seriously

explanation.surface: Following on from the mushrooms, eating them by mouth, perhaps as a joke.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to the mushrooms in the previous clue; 'by way of mouth' also hints at eating.
explanation.definitionFit: To ingest is to take food into the body, i.e. to eat or swallow it.

clue.text: At heart Wagner, stricken by fear, worried persistently

indicators.note: at heart takes the central letters of the composer's name

parts.note: awed means filled with fearful wonder

explanation.surface: Wagner, terrified deep down, fretted endlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnawed means nagged or chewed away at, as a worry does constantly.

clue.text: Double a profit repeatedly

definitions.meaning: doubling one gain read as a phrase: one gain plus another gain
over and over, time after time

explanation.surface: Making twice the profit over and over.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half is a cryptic reading: double 'a gain' and you have a gain, and a gain.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means over and over, many times in succession, and also literally doubles a gain.

clue.text: Girl has a fish — it's strengthening

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name
ling is a fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A girl owns a fish that makes her stronger.
explanation.definitionFit: Annealing is heat-treating metal or glass to toughen it, so it strengthens.

clue.text: School supported by Eastern dynasty is intriguing

indicators.note: in a down clue, supported by puts the school on top of what follows

parts.note: the Ming dynasty ruled China

explanation.surface: A school backed by an Oriental ruling house is up to something.
explanation.definitionFit: Intriguing in the sense of plotting secretly is what scheming means.

clue.text: Char and lance swimming in Gulf state pursuing glaucous water primarily

indicators.note: pursuing puts the Gulf state after the letters before it
swimming suggests the letters are floating about in disorder
primarily takes the first letters of the words

parts.note: Oman is a state on the Persian Gulf

explanation.surface: A char fish and a lance swim in a sea-green Gulf.
explanation.walkthrough: Char is the fish in the surface but means a cleaner. 'swimming' turns LANCE into CLEAN; then IN, GW from 'primarily', and OMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Char, short for charwoman, is British for a woman paid to clean houses.

clue.text: Without horse, Opposition leader is in minority

parts.note: no means without
a nag is an old horse
Ed Miliband led the Opposition in Britain when the puzzle appeared

explanation.surface: Lacking a horse, the Opposition leader belongs to a minority.
explanation.walkthrough: Minority here is the legal state of being under age, not a smaller group.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonage is the period of legal minority, so nonaged describes someone under age.

clue.text: Bleat about chap in pink

indicators.note: about means wrapped around, so the bleat surrounds the man

parts.note: maa is the bleat of a sheep or goat
a gent is a chap

explanation.surface: A man dressed in pink complains.
explanation.definitionFit: Magenta is a purplish-pink colour, a shade of pink.

clue.text: Shift to be exhibited in church

indicators.note: in places the display inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a painting hangs when it is put on show

explanation.surface: A rearrangement to be displayed in church.
explanation.definitionFit: A shift is an alteration, and a change is the same thing.

clue.text: Ecstasy used by director-general in government fringe

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A drug taken by a senior official in a fringe part of government.
explanation.definitionFit: Edging is a border or trim, which is what a fringe is.

clue.text: Game bird — that's understood

parts.note: Go is a board game
a tit is a small bird

explanation.surface: A shooter nods knowingly at a game bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'got it' means you have grasped something, so it signals comprehension.

clue.text: It shows how far one's gone to follow discussion in American state

definitions.text: It shows how far one's gone

indicators.note: in puts the following and discussion inside the state

parts.note: OH is the postal abbreviation for Ohio
to dog someone is to follow them
a rap is an American term for a talk or discussion

explanation.surface: A device tracks a traveller's distance in Ohio during a discussion.
explanation.definitionFit: An odograph records distance travelled, like an odometer that plots the route.

clue.text: Earth is seen to be first-class in Georgia

indicators.note: in places first-class inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for Georgia
A1 is a term for first-class, here written AI

explanation.surface: The land is first-rate in Georgia.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 is read as the letters AI.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaia is the Greek goddess personifying the planet, so a name for it.

clue.text: Altering itself is intrinsic

indicators.note: itself says the word altering acts on its own letters, rearranging them

explanation.surface: Changing oneself is a fundamental matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Altering' is both the fodder and, through 'itself', its own anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Integral means essential to the whole, so inherent or intrinsic.

clue.text: Old officer's nuts to get cocktail of gin

parts.note: ens are printers' spaces, also called nuts

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A retired officer is mad keen on a gin cocktail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nuts' is not crazy but the printers' en, also called a nut.
explanation.definitionFit: An ensign was formerly the lowest commissioned infantry officer, carrying the colours.

clue.text: Talk about European mixed diet and become overambitious

indicators.note: about places the talk around what follows

parts.note: to gas is to chatter

indicators.note: mixed means stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Chatter about a varied European diet makes someone aim too high.
explanation.definitionFit: To get ideas is to start aspiring above your station, an idiom for overreaching.

clue.text: Confused mass of seaweed

definitions.meaning: a knotted, muddled heap of things
a name for a large brown kelp

explanation.surface: A jumble of seaweed on a beach.
explanation.definitionFit: A snarl is a confused mass, and kelp of the genus Laminaria bears the same name.
